option.label: Color theme
option.description: Sets the color theme for button LEDs. Select 'Custom' to use colors defined in the 'Custom color theme' section.

option.label: Match pad colors to on-screen colors
option.description: Use on-screen colors for pad LEDs while in hotcues or stems mode. Normal theme colors will be used if this option is off.

option.label: Use bright VU meter segments
option.description: Use full brightness for VU meter LED segments. Dimmed LED brightness will be used if this option is off.

option.label: Use bright bottom panel standby light
option.description: Use full brightness for bottom panel standby light effect. This is especially useful with a static always on standby light.

option.description: Color for the effect focus button.

option.label: FX toggle buttons

option.description: Color for effect unit assign buttons.

option.label: Prepare button

option.label: Active mode button
option.description: Color for the active pad mode button.

option.label: Unconnected pads
option.description: Color for unconnected pads. Used for unset hotcues, unloaded sampers and modifier pads.

option.label: Inactive pads
option.description: Color for connected, but currently inactive pads.

option.label: Active pads
option.description: Color for currently active pads.

option.label: Alternate mode pads
option.description: Color for currently active pads in alternate mode. This includes looping samplers and pads activated while holding 'Shift'.

option.label: Quick FX button
option.description: Color for Quick FX toggle buttons. Quick FX preset colors take preference over this setting.

option.label: Headphone button
option.description: Color for headphone cue buttons.

option.label: Talkover button
option.description: Color for the talkover button.

option.label: Signal peak indicators
option.description: Color for the main output and microphone input peak indicator LEDs.

option.label: Alternate mode indicators
option.description: Color for buttons in alternate mode. Used by sync leader (MST) button when long range rate faders are active.

option.label: Jogging and nudging sensitivity
option.description: Sensitivity for turning the wheel by touching only the outer ring. Higher settings will allow for faster jogging and nudging movement.

option.label: Movement smoothing
option.description: Controls jog wheel's movement smoothing. Higher settings produce smooth but less responsive movement, while lower settings produce snappy but noisier movement.

option.label: Input dead zone
option.description: Adjusts the jog wheel's input dead zone. Higher settings ignore more subtle movements, but can make the wheel feel less responsive.

option.label: Fine scratching speed
option.description: Controls the scratching speed when 'Shift' button is held.

option.label: Quick seek speed
option.description: Controls the jog wheel's quick seek speed when 'Shift' button is held.

option.label: Align quick seek to beatgrid
option.description: Align quick seek wheel movements to beatgrid. If the track doesn't have a beatgrid, seconds will be used instead.

option.label: Long press timeout
option.description: Time in milliseconds required to hold a button before a long press is registered.

option.label: Rate fader midpoint snapping
option.description: Range over which rate faders automatically snap to the midpoint.

option.label: Make shift button presses global
option.description: Use either 'Shift' button to control shifted functions on both decks.

option.label: Enable soft takeover for knobs and faders
option.description: Ignore knob and fader movements until they pass the current on-screen position. This can prevent sudden level jumps when physical and on-screen controls are out of sync.

option.label: Use rolling loop pads by default
option.description: Use rolling loops as the default loop pad mode. Regular loops can be activated by holding the 'Shift' button.

option.label: Enable master gain knob control
option.description: Use Mixxx's master gain knob instead of sending audio directly to the output. Enabling this is not recommended as it can lead to audio clipping issues.
